Three failed cleanup attempts could release admission once the process was dead, without proving buffers were released. Admission now remains held until close succeeds; first cleanup failure stays nonready.

verified_boundaries: Actual router HTTP inspect -> returned explicit actions -> recover through real spawned workers; downloaded text checksum/size, ordinary Design reload and independent input replay all pass.
Original file/source and a different occupied document retain exact session identity, Design, revision, undo and redo. No workspace or live server mutation.
Admission precedes upload; malformed framing, duplicate metadata, unsupported schemas, strict policy and busy work refuse without native work.
Repeated cancellation and disconnect drain the supervisor; child and shared-memory cleanup finish before admission release. A delayed response retains the slot through final ASGI send.
Policy generation is rechecked before native work and delivery. Existing strict routing remains closed; the frontend sends normal document identity solely for policy context.

Full escaped response is capped at16MB. The exact server-encoded ASCII document text preserves integer/float spelling and Unicode escapes; neither browser nor parent reserializes a parsed Design for download.

Frontend requires original-byte receipt matching, explicit repair selection and exclusions acknowledgment; stale file/reply/hash, cancellation, failed proof/validation or checksum mismatch cannot enable download.
Existing numerical thread policy is shared by both worker entry points; spawned runtime regression preserves parent pools/environment. Molecular kernels, constants and numerical pins are unchanged.

architecture.deadline_limit: Shared thread scheduling and OS resource reclamation are cooperative, not a hard wall-clock termination guarantee. Cleanup failure retains admission rather than allocating another worker.
architecture.retention: One shared native-worker slot through final send; no queue, second job catalog, retained candidate host or active-document lock.
architecture.pruning: Extracted the existing cancellation-draining thread helper from source transport and reused it; extracted the existing numerical thread context for both workers. No speculative deletion of unrelated legacy readers.
